preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: The input sequence a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: is_valid_tree(p) and changes == sum(1 for i in range(n) if p[i] != a[i])
postconditions.description: The output sequence p is a valid tree representation, and the reported number of changes equals the count of positions where p differs from the input a.
The number of changes is the minimum possible among all valid tree sequences derivable from a.

postconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
postconditions.description: The output sequence p has length n and contains only integers between 1 and n.
